responsibilities: ask and answer the mandatory last-mistake question at the start of every round
review the complete Packaging Failure Journal and arm every historical regression gate

review actual /usecomputer installation, launch, function, Repair and Uninstall evidence
make the round and final acceptance decisions

call build, static checks or unpacked proof an installed validation
let an idle scheduler mark a pending task in progress

build one new candidate identity per round
perform actual installed launch and basic-function checks
perform candidate-specific Repair, Uninstall and cleanup

repair an installed candidate manually and then accept its original media
repeat an installation without a new discriminating change
touch another Aptenra instance or the original Debug Runtime
claim success from theory, source inspection, process state, ports or health alone

responsibilities: review last-mistake answers and historical gate coverage
review the diagnosed responsibility layer and repair scope
review final media identity and preinstall evidence
reject any repeated known signature or overbroad success wording
must_not: waive a historical gate without evidence and rationale
treat MSI return code zero as whole-package acceptance
substitute static checks for actual installed user-view tests

responsibilities: provide new authority when the loop reaches an explicit await_human boundary
must_not: be treated as implicitly approving reboots, other-instance changes or external publication
